{{Quote|Nay!|Punn Rimbaud votes against opening peace negotiations with the Galactic Republic|<ref name="HOBS" />}}
'''Punn Rimbaud''' was an [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibian]]<ref name="EpGuide" /> [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] of the [[Separatist Senate/Legends|Separatist Parliament]] alongside several other members of their [[Punn Rimbaud's species/Legends|species]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="HOBS" /> In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TCWdates|310}}</ref> while present on the Separatist [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Raxus Secundus/Legends|Raxus Secundus]], they opposed<ref name="HOBS" /> senator of<ref name="WOTF">{{TCW|A War on Two Fronts}}</ref> the planet<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]<ref name="WOTF" /> [[Mina Bonteri/Legends|Mina Bonteri's]] [[Confederate–Republic peace initiative/Legends|initiative for peace]] between the Confederacy and the Republic, shouting in vocal protest. When prompted by the [[Head of State/Legends|leader]] of the Confederacy, [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], Rimbaud voted nay. However, the initiative received a majority vote in its favor and was ultimately passed on to the Republic, who denied the peace treaty. Rimbaud had [[Color/Legends|brown]] skin and black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and wore a white [[Clothing/Legends|outfit]] with red and black accents.<ref name="HOBS" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
Penn Rimbaud appeared in "[[Heroes on Both Sides]],"<ref name="HOBS" /> the tenth episode in the [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|third season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, which released on [[November 19]], [[2010]].<ref name="EpGuideBook">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Episode Guide]]''</ref> They were first identified in the accompanying [[StarWars.com]] [[The Clone Wars Episode Guides|Episode Guide]] released on the same day.<ref name="EpGuide" />
